findings.title: CSRF validation removed from state-changing payout POST
findings.rationale: The handler still accepts a browser cookie session. Comment claims the gateway checks CSRF, but this route is also mounted on the internal app without that gateway. State-changing money POST with no CSRF is a substantive defect.

rationale: Structural heuristics looking for tenant/id lookups will miss this. The defect is an omitted check, not a new unsafe query.
